ease.reason: A sample trigger and test inbox could scope the first experiment; no attached reference documents this integration.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a professional-services operator may value a dependable notification; the request proves no AI-service demand.

feasibility.reason: A mocked trigger-to-test-email flow fits four weeks, but provider setup and error handling are undocumented here.

candidates.reason: Assessed a narrow operator-controlled trigger-to-test-inbox prototype. No attached implementation reference supports the integration; the equal-weight mean is below 6.
